title: Inside a desktop computer
alt: A desktop computer in a blue case, seen through its clear side window: the motherboard fills the back, a round fan glowing green covers the processor, sticks of memory stand beside it, a long graphics card lies across the middle, and drives sit in a bay at the bottom.
author: Tiia Monto
description: A homebuilt desktop computer inside a blue-colored case Fractal Design Focus G ATX with a plastic window. Including the components: motherboard (Asus TUF B450-PLUS GAMING AM4 ATX), RAM memory (G.Skill RipjawsV DDR4), video card (Asus Cerberus GTX 1070 Ti) and processor (Ryzen 7 2700X).
